final_text: All 327 tests now pass (1 skipped, 1 xfailed). The fix was exactly as described in the handoff note: the `build_connection_pool_key_attributes` method was calling `_urllib3_request_context` with only 3 arguments, but the function signature had been updated to require a 4th `poolmanager` argument. Adding `self.poolmanager` as the 4th parameter resolved all the failures.
